name: The Fallen Temple of Mercury
description: A ruined Roman temple town hidden within a Magic regio, once a center of the Cult of Mercury, containing a forum, basilica, baths, aqueduct and the temple itself.

name: Forum (Temple of Mercury)
description: A large open-roofed marble-flagged meeting area and market place in the temple town, with a raised pulpit at its northern end.

name: Basilica (Temple of Mercury)
description: A three-storied domed building of offices that housed administrators for the Cult of Mercury and the legionary garrison, including the Salary, Library, Correspondence, Municipal and Scrying Offices.

name: Scrying Office
description: A basilica office containing a damaged shallow pool connected to the aqueduct, a component of the Scrying Pool ritual.

name: Aqueduct (Temple of Mercury)
description: The dry, damaged aqueduct system of the temple town; its pipe is also a regio entrance and its source is a mountain spring that is an Aquam vis source.

name: The Aqueduct Spring
description: A distant mountain spring feeding the aqueduct; an Aquam vis source yielding vis in the first gallon at dawn of the Summer Solstice.

name: Baths (Temple of Mercury)
description: A ruined Roman bathing complex with pools of different temperatures, heated by furnace and underfloor venting and supplied by the aqueduct.

name: Necropolis Regio
description: A possible second regio (Magic aura 7) mirroring the temple town, always night, where those who die in the temple regio reappear as ghosts.

name: Durenmar
description: Covenant whose aura Trianoma reputedly increased by sacrificing herself.

name: Aventine Hill
description: Site where Bonisagus may have translated Mercurian rituals.

name: Devil's Lane
description: A small Faerie regio (aura 6) housing a faerie toy market, whose central looping lane has many alleyway entrances to cities throughout Mythic Europe.

name: Upside
description: One end of Devil's Lane; those who know how can walk to its end to enter the Faerie Realm.

name: Downside
description: The other end of Devil's Lane; on Walpurgis Night an entrance to Hell briefly appears there.

name: Devil's Lane Workshops
description: A labyrinth of candle-lit basements beneath Devil's Lane where worker elves create the magic toys.

name: Bartholomew's Laboratory
description: A tiny faerie regio (Faerie aura 8) reached by a spiral stairway from Julia's laboratory, where the senile Bartholomew dozes by the fire.

name: Julia's Laboratory
description: The ground-floor sanctum of the Devil's Lane covenant, a spooky chamber filled with bleached bones and skulls.

name: Acre Avenue
description: An alleyway leading from Devil's Lane serving as a regio entrance to its eponymous city.

name: Barcelona Street
description: An alleyway leading from Devil's Lane serving as a regio entrance to its eponymous city.

name: Bologna Way
description: An alleyway leading from Devil's Lane serving as a regio entrance to its eponymous city.

name: Bordeaux Street
description: An alleyway leading from Devil's Lane serving as a regio entrance to its eponymous city.

name: Cairo Way
description: An alleyway leading from Devil's Lane serving as a regio entrance to its eponymous city.

name: Cologne Avenue
description: An alleyway leading from Devil's Lane serving as a regio entrance to its eponymous city. It is currently bricked up due to civic reconstruction city-side.

name: Constantinople Street
description: An alleyway leading from Devil's Lane serving as a regio entrance to its eponymous city. It is currently bricked up due to civic reconstruction city-side.

name: Florence Avenue
description: An alleyway leading from Devil's Lane serving as a regio entrance to its eponymous city. The Devil's Lane covenant stands opposite it.

name: London Street
description: An alleyway leading from Devil's Lane serving as a regio entrance to its eponymous city.

name: Paris Way
description: An alleyway leading from Devil's Lane serving as a regio entrance to its eponymous city.

name: Prague Street
description: An alleyway leading from Devil's Lane serving as a regio entrance to its eponymous city.

name: No-Name Street
description: An alleyway leading from Devil's Lane serving as a regio entrance to its eponymous city. It is bricked up and nobody knows where it led.

name: Cologne
description: City whose Devil's Lane entrance was destroyed by reconstruction; the market guild regalia is modeled on its guilds.

name: Constantinople
description: City whose Devil's Lane entrance was destroyed by reconstruction; its 1204 siege is depicted on a faerie tapestry.

name: Bologna
description: City where part of Greta's coven lives.

name: Florence
description: City where part of Greta's coven lives.

name: London
description: City linked to Devil's Lane via an alleyway ('London-side').

name: Paris
description: City linked to Devil's Lane via an alleyway ('Paris-side').

name: Black Forest
description: Forest whose satyrs are forever denied entry to Devil's Lane.

name: Hell
description: The Infernal Realm; an entrance to it briefly opens at the end of Downside on Walpurgis Night.

name: Rhine
description: Region beyond Roman territory where the temple could be located on a site sacred to Germanic cults.

name: Mythic Europe
description: The setting in which Devil's Lane has multiple urban entrances.

name: Roman Empire
description: The ancient empire whose legionaries garrisoned the temple town; its records can be studied as Organization Lore: Roman Empire.

name: Faerie Realm
description: The realm reachable from Upside at the end of Devil's Lane.

name: Magic Realm
description: The realm where the god Mercury exists.

name: Infernal
description: The realm tainting the Godhead demon's gifts and vis.

name: Cult of Mercury
description: The Roman priesthood of Mercury whose correspondence, rituals and eventual collapse are recorded at the temple.

name: Order of False Gods
description: Infernal order of demons to which the Godhead belongs.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The order of magi, which might March the characters over infernal pacts.

name: House Bjornaer
description: Hermetic House that grew out of Germanic cults.

name: House Merinita
description: Faerie-focused Hermetic House; Bartholomew and Julia are Merinita.

name: House Guernicus
description: Hermetic House whose agents may learn of the temple.

name: Redcaps
description: Hermetic messengers who hold documents about the toy market entrances.

name: Quaesitors
description: Hermetic investigators who may investigate faerie items near a covenant.

name: Seekers
description: Hermetic group who may seek the temple.

name: Mystery Cult
description: A cult for which the temple is part of its Initiation rituals.

name: Market Guild
description: Guild of faerie merchants that sets and enforces the Devil's Lane market rules through a council.

name: Greta's Coven
description: A folk witch coven, mostly living city-side in Bologna and Florence.

name: Folk Witch
description: Hedge tradition to which Greta belongs.

name: Devil's Lane Covenant
description: A Merinita covenant opposite Florence Avenue, founded by Bartholomew after his Gauntlet, home to him and Julia.

name: Mercury
description: Roman god with a temple in the regio; exists in the Magic realm and can be contacted by ritual.

name: The Godhead
description: A demon of the Order of False Gods, an invisible stone head replacing Mercury's statue head, who poses as Mercury to corrupt magi.

name: Bonisagus
description: Hermetic founder who based Hermetic magic partly on Mercurian magic.

name: Trianoma
description: Reputedly sacrificed herself to increase the aura of Durenmar.

name: Emperor Constantine
description: Roman Emperor whose adoption of Christianity in 313 AD marks the limit of Mercury's knowledge.

name: Sir Callum
description: A young faerie-blooded knight who gives a Rain Parasol as a gift at a baron's feast.

name: Walter the Book Merchant
description: A faerie merchant-scribe on Devil's Lane selling glamour books and exercise slates.

name: Bartholomew
description: An ancient, senile Merinita magus near Final Twilight who founded the Devil's Lane covenant.

name: Julia
description: A young Merinita maga, Bartholomew's former apprentice, specializing in necromancy and seeking her lost twin Leda.

name: Leda
description: Julia's twin sister, abducted by faeries at age five.

name: Mengalaz
description: Bartholomew's faerie rat familiar, leader of the rat pack.

name: The Three Sisters
description: Faerie merchant sisters Lo'relyn, Fi'noa and De'dee sharing a council vote; sell Rain Parasols.

name: Count Thorstein
description: A flamboyant centaur merchant and guild councilor.

name: Guild-Master Wendell
description: The pedantic self-appointed leader of the merchant guild, selling wands.

name: Guild-Mistress Greta
description: A faerie-blooded folk witch councilor selling potions.

name: Felix the Wolf
description: A black wolf guild member who enforces the guild rules.

name: Tarlan the Wolf
description: ArM5 wolf whose statistics are used for Felix.

name: Satan
description: Legend says Devil's Lane is his bridge to the Faerie Realm.

name: Devil's Lane Goblin Rats
description: Vicious faerie-blooded rats forming the Devil's Lane rat pack.

name: Worker Elves
description: Identical faerie elves who create magic toys in the workshops.

name: Foremen Elves
description: Four elves who command the worker elves.

name: Satyrs of the Black Forest
description: Satyrs denied entry to Devil's Lane.

name: Ghost
description: Undead spirits; rules given for necropolis ghosts.

name: Demon
description: Infernal spirits; hundreds emerge from Hell on Walpurgis Night.

name: Faerie
description: Beings inhabiting Devil's Lane as merchants.

name: Legionaries
description: Roman soldiers garrisoned at the temple town.

name: Faerie Queen
description: Owner of a salt mine used as punishment.

name: Purification
description: CrCo 40 Mercurian ritual reducing Decrepitude and apparent age, cast in a consecrated temple of Mercury.

name: The Scrying Pool
description: InIm 20 Mercurian ritual for seeing a target via the Scrying Office pool.

name: Raising the Auxiliaries for a Day
description: CrMe 35 ritual granting up to 100 characters +1 Attack/Defense.

name: Penetrate the Regio Skin
description: Cr(Re)Vi 25 ritual creating a new entrance through a Magic regio boundary.

name: Blessing of Mercury
description: CrVi 30 ritual granting +3 to Casting and Laboratory totals for a Year.

name: Transformation of Flesh to Spirit
description: CrVi(Co) 60 ritual in which the caster kills herself to increase the aura.

name: Wizard's Initiation
description: CrVi(Co) 75 ritual meant to grant The Gift, which fails in the Age of Pisces.

name: Consecration of Mercury's House
description: CrVi 55 ritual consecrating a temple to Mercury and creating a Magic aura 1.

name: Commune with Mercury
description: InVi 20 ritual to commune with the god Mercury.

name: Mercurian Rituals
description: Non-Hermetic rituals of the Cult of Mercury, recoverable from Lab Texts and translatable into Hermetic rituals.

name: Wizard's Communion
description: MuVi spell letting magi combine casting; Mercurian versions exist.

name: Pilum of Fire
description: Spell used as example of what a ghost cannot target at the living.

name: Piercing the Faerie Veil
description: InVi 20 spell to see faerie regio boundaries.

name: Wizard's Sidestep
description: ReIm 10 spell known by Julia (mastered) and Bartholomew.

name: Lay to Rest the Haunting Spirit
Coerce the Spirits of the Night
Demon's Eternal Oblivion
description: PeVi spell known by both Julia and Bartholomew.

name: True Rest of the Injured Brute
Opening the Tome of the Animal's Mind
Transformation of the Ravenous Beast to the Torpid Toad
Calm the Motion of the Heart
Shroud the Stench of the Pit
description: Godhead's power disguising his infernal powers and taint from Hermetic detection.

name: Coagulation
description: Demon power to form a physical body; the Godhead's is an invisible stone head.

name: Envisioning
description: Demon power to appear in dreams.

name: Grant Magical Power
description: Godhead power granting Puissant Art, tainted with the infernal.

name: Obsession
description: Demon power infecting sinners with a Personality Trait.

name: Leaving the Crypt
description: Necropolis ghost power to physically affect the living for a Diameter.

name: Read it
description: Walter's power to discuss any book his audience has read.

name: Workshop Helper
description: Worker elf power to create magic items and assist Lab work.

name: Workshop Foreman
description: Foreman elf power to command worker elves.

name: Devil's Mind
description: Mengalaz's power making him aware of everything in Devil's Lane.

name: Hands of the Animal
description: Mengalaz's power to manipulate objects as with hands.

name: Shared Powers
description: Familiar power letting the master use familiar's powers.

name: Shared Fatigue
description: Familiar power sharing Might and Fatigue.

name: Location
description: Familiar power to know where the master is.

name: The Annals of Mercury
description: Book recording the temple's history, ending 'We thought that we would go on forever.'

name: Statue of Mercury
description: Decapitated marble statue of Mercury in the cella.

name: Bird Bane
description: MuAn 44 harness giving a cat feathered wings.

name: The Book of Beasts
description: InAn 10 book whose pages are Arcane Connections to beasts.

name: The Dove Hat
description: CrAn 30 hat producing a white dove.

name: The Forest Giant
description: CrHe 40 acorn growing into an oak overnight.

name: Green Flame Powder
description: MuIg 10 powder making fire burn lime green.

name: Hat That Grants the Over-Anxious Father Peace of Mind
description: InCo 24 hat wearable only by a virgin.

name: Hen Dust
description: CrAn 40 dust making a chick hatch and grow to adult.

name: Love Potion
description: ReMe 30 potion causing love for the first person seen.

name: The Magic Money Box
description: MuTe 45 box turning stones into gold coins.

name: One Romantic Evening
description: CrHe 10 rose petal carpeting the ground with roses.

name: Rain Parasol
description: CrAu 40 parasol creating a miniature storm.

name: The Rat Pipe
description: ReAn 55 pipe attracting all vermin in a building.

name: The Siege of Constantinople
description: CrIm 15 animated tapestry of the 1204 siege.

name: The Scrying Bowls
description: InAq 30 paired bowls for visual scrying.

name: Wand of Horses
description: MuAn 26 wand turning vermin into horses.

name: The Wooden Knights
description: Invested puppet knights with Read the Master's Thoughts and Move the Limbs.

name: Glamour Exercise Slates
description: Glamour completed exercise slates sold by Walter.

name: Regio
description: Hidden supernatural area; the temple and Devil's Lane are regiones.

name: Magic Aura
description: Supernatural aura of the Magic realm.

name: Vis
description: Magical raw material; main currency of Devil's Lane.

name: Integration Breakthrough
description: Research to incorporate non-Hermetic magic into Hermetic theory.

name: Age of Pisces
description: Current astrological age in which Wizard's Initiation fails.

name: Astrological Ages
description: ~2160-year ages defined by vernal equinox sign.

name: Walpurgis Night
description: 30 April, when an entrance to Hell opens at Downside.

name: Glamour
description: Faerie illusion; the toys are glamour lasting seven years.

name: Familiar
description: Magical animal companion bound to a magus.

name: Leaden Cord
description: Faerie familiar cord hindering Divine interactions.

name: Iron Cord
description: Faerie familiar cord hindering with iron.

name: Tin Cord
description: Faerie familiar cord penalizing outside auras.

name: Twilight
description: Warping state; Julia and Bartholomew have Twilight Scars.

name: Talisman
description: Item the workshop elves cannot create.

name: Second Sight
description: Ability to see through illusions and regio boundaries.

name: Faith Points
description: Lost within Consecration of Mercury's House.

name: Chapter House
description: Possible use of the temple site.

name: The Gift
description: Magical talent; Wizard's Initiation attempts to grant it.

name: Death Prophecy
description: False prophecy granted by the Godhead.

name: Puissant Art
description: Virtue granted by Godhead; Julia (Corpus) and Bartholomew (Imaginem) have it.

name: Faerie Speech
description: Faerie power to speak human languages.

name: Organization Lore
description: Lore Ability; Roman Empire, Cult of Mercury, Order of Hermes.

name: Magic Theory
description: Needed to read Mercurian Lab Texts.

name: Finesse
description: Used to control Penetrate the Regio Skin.

name: Order of Hermes Lore
description: Used to link ritual to Trianoma.
